title: Global Importance Estimation for KV Cache Eviction
abstract: arXiv:2611.24969v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Memory consumption of the key-value (KV) cache remains a central bottleneck for long-context LLM inference. We introduce PRKV, a training-free KV eviction method that estimates multi-hop global token importance by applying Personalized PageRank over attention-induced transition graphs. This enables importance propagation beyond recency or instantaneous attention, without modifying the model. We benchmark PRKV on long-context understanding, sparse retrieval, and chain-of-thought reasoning tasks using multiple LLM families. Under moderate to aggressive compression ratios, including up to 90%, PRKV achieves competitive task performance against established eviction baselines while reducing peak memory usage with low end-to-end overhead. These results demonstrate that multi-hop global influence estimation yields a favorable accuracy--memory trade-off for scalable long-context inference.

translated_title: KV缓存淘汰的全局重要性估计
translated_abstract: 键值（KV）缓存的内存消耗仍然是长上下文大语言模型推理的核心瓶颈。我们提出了PRKV，一种无需训练的KV缓存淘汰方法，它通过在注意力诱导的转移图上应用个性化PageRank来估计token的多跳全局重要性。这使得重要性传播能够超越基于近期性或瞬时注意力的方法，且无需修改模型。我们使用多个大语言模型系列，在长上下文理解、稀疏检索和思维链推理任务上对PRKV进行了基准测试。在从中等到激进（包括高达90%）的压缩比率下，PRKV相对于已有的淘汰基线方法取得了具有竞争力的任务性能，同时以较低的端到端开销降低了峰值内存使用。这些结果表明，多跳全局影响力估计为可扩展的长上下文推理带来了良好的准确性与内存之间的权衡。
tldr: PRKV是一种无需训练的KV缓存淘汰方法，通过在注意力转移图上应用个性化PageRank估计token的多跳全局重要性，即使压缩率高达90%也能保持竞争性任务性能并显著降低峰值内存。
en_tdlr: PRKV is a training-free KV cache eviction method that estimates multi-hop global token importance via Personalized PageRank on attention-induced transition graphs, achieving competitive task performance and reduced peak memory even at compression ratios up to 90%.
